rules: Each frame carries one set, or no set for a free workout with totalSets and offset equal to zero.
Metadata is identical across frames and uses the existing create_workout scalar contract.
An optional interval or metrics field, when present in the first frame, must be present in every frame.
Only the exact next offset or an identical already persisted frame is accepted.
Every send uses a fresh attemptId; a partial acknowledgement echoes that exact attempt and cannot advance another attempt.
A partial acknowledgement reports the next offset only after durable account-bound staging.
The existing whole-workout acknowledgement is sent only after full validation and durable workout import.
A partial acknowledgement never removes the workout from the watch queue.
One incomplete transfer is retained per trusted device and active account; expired state may be replaced only from offset zero.
Receivers retain support for the released create_workout message. Older receivers ignore the new frame type, leaving the watch queue intact.
